heur_ev.label: rank-and-fill with recourse, settings tuned by E[NPV]

heur_ce.label: rank-and-fill with recourse, settings tuned by CE (oracle)

rn.label: risk-neutral two-stage MIP at the strip (plan reused: it does not depend on rho)

rn_tilt1.label: pi-tilted risk-neutral MIP, one fixed-point iteration from rn (time includes rn)

rn_tilt2.label: pi-tilted risk-neutral MIP, two fixed-point iterations from rn (time includes rn, rn_tilt1)

rn_deck.label: risk-neutral MIP at the oracle-selected planning deck (grid 0.7-1.05 by 0.05; best 1.0); time includes rn

ce.label: certified CE solver seeded with rn, heur_ce, rn_tilt2 (time includes the seeds)

heur_ev+rn_recourse.label: first stage of heur_ev, risk-neutral recourse

heur_ev+exact_recourse.label: first stage of heur_ev, certified CE recourse

heur_ce+exact_recourse.label: first stage of heur_ce, certified CE recourse

rn+exact_recourse.label: first stage of rn, certified CE recourse

rn_deck+exact_recourse.label: first stage of rn_deck, certified CE recourse

rn_tilt2+exact_recourse.label: first stage of rn_tilt2, certified CE recourse

mv_rn.label: mean-value first stage (theta = P = 1, risk-neutral) with risk-neutral recourse on the tree

ce_committed.label: certified CE plan with one recourse shared by all nodes (committed)

plan_format.encoding: z0/zk: positions in idx0/idx1; y: packages; w0: units; wk: per node, u * (T - 1) + (t - 1)

block_selection.rule: 8x10 windows with pairs on township rows, every section in McKenzie County and in R94-98W, T148-152N; keep the windows with the highest 1280-acre DSU match; choose the one with most laterals first producing 2018-2024

bench_classifier.tvd_source: median TVD of LAT1 survey stations with inclination > 85 deg (bottom-hole TVD if no survey)

parents.rule: LAT1 laterals in the Bakken TVD window, first production on or before the planning date and oil reported in 2024 or status A; a lateral is a parent of the unit holding most of its length (>= 0.5 mi) and of any other unit holding >= 1.0 mi

ownership.wi_rule: no public working-interest field: owned 0.75 (disclosed operated average), acquired 0.75

calibration_sample.rule: wells within 10.0 mi of the block, first production 2018-2024, lateral 1.5-2.5 mi, 12 months of history
calibration_sample.imputation: months withheld while confidential are filled by ratio: observed oil / mean share of those months in complete wells' first-12-month oil

bench_ratio.model: log(q12 per mile) ~ quadratic trend in (x, y) + bench + first-production year

type_curve.sample: wells near the block, first production 2018-2019, complete first 12 months

well_variogram.note: flat beyond 0.5 mi: the well-level variogram does not identify a range at unit scale

field.rule: residuals of log(q12 per mile) after a quadratic trend, bench and vintage effects; sd = between-unit variance component (1 x 2 mi cells); range = Matern 3/2 range reproducing the variance of 2 x 2-unit means; sd_bench = sd_log x mean mu of the bench (delta method)

mu.kernel: Gaussian, sd 2.0 mi, wells within 6.0 mi of the unit center

producing_base.note: share of a new well's PV5 still to come from a parent of the type-curve shape at its age on the planning date; the model counts every parent in the block, owned or not, at PDP_REMAIN = 0.6
producing_base.applied_2026_10_04: base_parents = parents in owned units only (the planning operator's wells; other operators' parents still occupy lanes and interfere); pdp_remain = 0.265, the implied mean remaining share. Set after the builder ran, by the model's instance overrides.

deadlines.rule: owned unit without producing parents and a state lease (or auctioned tract, primary term 5 years) expiring in 2025-2028: deadline = expiry year - 2025; else T-1. Units with producing parents are held by production.

capacities.rig_source: x_nd_daily_rigs 2022: rows for BURLINGTON RESOURCES OIL GAS in McKenzie County / 247 daily reports
capacities.note: formulas of instance.make_instance with wpy = rig-days / 25; daily rig lists exist only for 2021-08 to 2022-12

packages.rule: unowned units in 2x2 blocks (two columns x two pairs); price = median bonus per acre of x_nd_lease_auction_results 2019-2024 in the unit's township (else the 3x3 or 5x5 township neighborhood; else the 5x5 or 7x7 neighborhood in 2013-2018; else the county) x 1280 acres; nominal dollars

posterior.rule: condition_field(mu_prior, Sigma_prior, parents, sig_eps, rng(seed 0)); posterior mean kept at the prior

provenance.data_copied: 2026-10-02 / 2026-10-04 from a local copy of the public NDIC layers
